The 94:50 court outline, centre line/circle, two lane keys, both three-point boundaries, two backboards and two rim contours remain. Rim diameters are enlarged to 8 mm, backboards to 13 mm, and both are moved inward to preserve separation. These deliberate marker/layout departures mean the drawing is not a scale regulation court.", "canvas_mm": [170, 115]}, "teaching": "The 94:50 court outline, centre line/circle, two lane keys, both three-point boundaries, two backboards and two rim contours remain.
